title: Tokenflow Thermostat: distributed SSE/WS load harness with KV-cache awareness and p95 regression gating
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Build a distributed load-testing harness (SSE + WebSocket) that models real-world chat/completion sessions with KV cache locality, connection churn, and dynamic token pacing. The goal is to produce reliable tokens/sec and p95 latency signals for the serving runtime and to gate regressions via automated statistical detection. This harness must support long-lived multiplexed sessions, configurable KV cache hit ratios, and real-time metric export to our observability stack.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end harness that can spawn 50k concurrent logical sessions across a region using both SSE and WS protocols
Synthetic session profiles with configurable sequence length distributions, prefix cache hits (0-90%), and token emission models (bursting vs steady)
p95 and tokens/sec computed per-minute and exported to metrics pipeline with labels: protocol, region, model_variant, kvcache_hit_pct
Automated regression detector that compares current run to baseline using bootstrapped confidence intervals and raises an alert if p95 regresses > 15% with p<0.01
Support for controlled capacity-failure modes (node drain, increased latency, packet loss) to validate graceful fallback and reroute policies
Runbook section describing how to run harness at scale, interpret outputs, and create a regression incident ticket
comments: 2025-09-18 - Aisha Raman: Ticket created. Initial scope scoped to region-level run; include both SSE and WS clients. Target baseline will be runtime-1.20 perf tests from July.

2025-09-21 - Marco Chen: Prototype of client simulator done (single-node). Implements token pacing, burst/steady modes, and simple KV-hit emulation via prefix table. Verified local runs up to 2k logical sessions.

2025-09-25 - Design decision: Use a distributed coordinator architecture (leader/worker) rather than peer-to-peer to simplify metrics aggregation and deterministic ramp profiles. Trade-off: leader is a single point for orchestration but is not in the data path.

2025-09-29 - Integration note: metric labels must include model_variant and kvcache_hit_pct to allow sliceable regression detection. Working with observability team to add label cardinality limits to avoid series explosion.

2025-10-01 - Review feedback from SRE (Jamie Ortiz): Add failure injection knobs for connection churn and TCP latency. Also request for ETA-based warmup phase to ensure KV caches reach configured hit ratios before measurements start.

2025-10-02 - Marco Chen: Implemented warmup and KV-priming stage. Distributed run orchestration tested on staging cluster (10 nodes) at 12k sessions. Exported metrics to 'tokenflow-thermostat-dashboard'. Next: integrate regression detector and create PR for infra changes.

Open TODOs: finalize regression parameters (window size, significance threshold), add automated ticket creation in CI when regression gates fail, and document resource/cost estimates for 50k-session runs.
